\begin{equation} R(x,t)\leq \frac{\exp (C_nK)}{(r-d_{g(t)}(p,x))^2} \quad (t\in [a,b],\ x\in B_{g(t)}(p,r)). \end{equation}
Proof

Apply the scalar evolution inequality to a distance cutoff on nested balls. Shortened minimizing segments supply upper supports at the cut locus. The reciprocal-time bound controls the time-dependent cutoff errors. Choosing its exponential weight with coefficient $C_nK$ absorbs those errors at a first positive maximum and yields (18). The initial term is controlled by $r^{-2}$.

□
